records.jp: 調子に乗ってんじゃないわよ！
records.en_original: You do NOT want to mess with us right now.
records.en_auxiliary: You do NOT want to mess with us right now.
records.en: You do NOT want to mess with us right now.

records.jp: ほら、さっさと白状しなさいよ
records.en_original: Come on, admit it already.
records.en_auxiliary: Come on, admit it already.
records.en: Come on, admit it already.

records.jp: うぅ……ぅ……
records.en_original: I, I.... *sob*
records.en: I, I.... *sob*

records.jp: ちょっと！　あなたたち、何してるの！
records.en_original: Hey! What do you think you're doing?
records.en_auxiliary: Hey! What do you think you're doing?
records.en: Hey! What do you think you're doing?

records.en_original: Ah...
records.en_auxiliary: Ah...
records.en: Ah...

records.jp: またあんた？　なんか用？
records.en_original: You again? What do you want?
records.en_auxiliary: You again? What do you want?
records.en: You again? What do you want?

records.jp: やめなよ。なんで千紘が犯人だって決めつけるの？
records.en_original: What do you THINK? Stop harassing Chihiro. Why do you think she's the culprit, anyway?
records.en_auxiliary: What do you THINK? Stop harassing Chihiro. Why do you think she's the culprit, anyway?
records.en: What do you THINK? Stop harassing Chihiro. Why do you think she's the culprit, anyway?

records.jp: この子が一番怪しいんだから当然でしょ？<CR>実際、一回も言い返してこないし
records.en_original: Have you ever seen anyone act more suspicious!? And she's never tried to DENY that she's the thief!
records.en_auxiliary: Have you ever seen anyone act more suspicious!? And she's never tried to DENY that she's the thief!
records.en: Have you ever seen anyone act more suspicious!? And she's never tried to DENY that she's the thief!

records.jp: それは……
records.en_original: That's...
records.en_auxiliary: That's...
records.en: That's...

records.jp: だいたい、あんたもいつまで良いご身分でいるつもり？
records.en_original: And you know what else? I'm sick of your high-and-mighty attitude. Stop acting like you're so important.
records.en_auxiliary: And you know what else? I'm sick of your high-and-mighty attitude.
records.en: And you know what else? I'm sick of your high-and-mighty attitude. Stop acting like you're so important.

records.jp: 膝の怪我で特待の推薦なくなったんでしょ？<CR>偉そうにされる筋合い、ないんだけど
records.en_original: Your knee injury kept you out of the special program, right? So you've got no reason to have such a big head.
records.en_auxiliary: Your knee injury kept you out of the special class, right? So you've got no reason to have such a big head.
records.en: Your knee injury kept you out of the special program, right? So you've got no reason to have such a big head.

records.en_original: How did you...!?
records.en_auxiliary: How did you...?!
records.en: How did you...!?

records.jp: 行くところがなくなったから普通科に来たって、<CR>みんな知ってるんだから
records.en_original: We all know you're only in the regular class here because you have nowhere else to go.
records.en_auxiliary: We all know you're only in the regular class here because you have nowhere else to go.
records.en: We all know you're only in the regular class here because you have nowhere else to go.

records.jp: ショックで家から出られなくなったんでしょ？<CR>だから学校にも通えてなかったって
records.en_original: And the shock of being regular was so much, you couldn't leave home. That's why you did't come to school, right?
records.en_auxiliary: And you were so shocked that you couldn't leave home, right? That's why you didn't come to school.
records.en: And the shock of being regular was so much, you couldn't leave home. That's why you did't come to school, right?

records.jp: （な、なんでこの子たちが怪我のこと知ってるの！？<CR>誰にも話してないのに）
records.en_original: (H-How do they know about my injury!? I didn't tell anyone!)
records.en_auxiliary: (H-how do they know about my injury!? I didn't tell anyone!)
records.en: (H-How do they know about my injury!? I didn't tell anyone!)

records.jp: （まさか更紗や早苗が……？<CR>……ううん、ありえない。でも）
records.en_original: (Did Sarasa or Sanae...? No, there's no way they'd do that. Still...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Did Sarasa or Sanae...? No, there's no way they'd do that. Still...)
records.en: (Did Sarasa or Sanae...? No, there's no way they'd do that. Still...)

records.jp: そういえば白井さんの歩き方って、なんかぎこちないよね？<CR>まだ足が治りきってないんじゃない？
records.en_original: Come to think of it, you walk with a bit of a limp, Shirai. Could it be that your leg hasn't healed yet?
records.en_auxiliary: Come to think of it, you walk with a bit of a limp, Shirai. Could it be that your leg hasn't healed yet?
records.en: Come to think of it, you walk with a bit of a limp, Shirai-san. Could it be that your leg hasn't healed yet?

records.jp: ほんとだ。ていうかもう治らないのかも。<CR>ひどいケガだったって聞いてるし、後を引いているとか
records.en_original: That's right... Maybe it won't ever heal. I heard it was pretty bad accident, so maybe it's permanent.
records.en_auxiliary: That's right... Maybe it won't ever heal. I heard it was a pretty bad accident, so maybe it's permanent.
records.en: That's right... Maybe it won't ever heal. I heard it was pretty bad accident, so maybe it's permanent.

records.jp: やめて……
records.en_original: Stop...
records.en_auxiliary: Stop...
records.en: Stop...

records.jp: もう、ずーっと今のまま
records.en_original: Stuck as a cripple, forever.
records.en_auxiliary: Stuck like this, forever.
records.en: Stuck as a cripple, forever.

records.jp: 一生元に戻らない
records.en_original: And you'll never be whole again.
records.en_auxiliary: You'll never go back to how you used to be.
records.en: And you'll never be whole again.

records.jp: やめて……やめてよ……
records.en_original: Stop it... Stop...
records.en_auxiliary: Stop it... Stop...
records.en: Stop it... Stop...

records.jp: その子のことだけだったら放っておいたんだけど――
records.en_original: I would have let you be if you were just picking on that other girl...
records.en_auxiliary: I would have let you be if you were just picking on that other girl...
records.en: I would have let you be if you were just picking on that other girl...

records.jp: ヒナちゃんのことまで悪く言うなら、許さない
records.en_original: But insulting Hina is where I draw the line.
records.en_auxiliary: But insulting Hina is where I draw the line.
records.en: But insulting Hina-chan is where I draw the line.

records.jp: ら、ライム……？
records.en_original: L-Lime...?
records.en_auxiliary: L-Lime...?
records.en: L-Lime...?

records.jp: なに？　あんたも泥棒の味方をするわけ？
records.en_original: What? Are you here to defend this little thief, too?
records.en_auxiliary: What? Are you here to defend this little thief, too?
records.en: What? Are you here to defend this little thief, too?

records.jp: さあ、泥棒はどっちかな？
records.en_original: Who's the real thief here, I wonder?
records.en_auxiliary: Who's the real thief here, I wonder?
records.en: Who's the real thief here, I wonder?

records.jp: これは……何の動画？
records.en_original: That's...a video?
records.en_auxiliary: That's...a video?
records.en: That's...a video?

records.jp: （これで二つ目。意外と楽勝ね）
records.en_original: (This makes two. This is easier than I thought.)
records.en_auxiliary: (This makes two. This is easier than I thought.)
records.en: (This makes two. This is easier than I thought.)

records.jp: この映像、まさか
records.en_original: Wait, is this video what I think it is?
records.en_auxiliary: Wait, is this video what I think it is?
records.en: Wait, is this video what I think it is?

records.jp: そう。あの子が盗んでいる現場の動画
records.en_original: That's right. Footage of our thief.
records.en_auxiliary: That's right. Footage of the real thief here.
records.en: That's right. Footage of our thief.

records.jp: で、でっちあげよ、そんなの！　だいたい、体育の授業中に<CR>他の生徒が教室にいられるはずないし……！　……あっ
records.en_original: Th-That's ridiculous! Besides, students aren't allowed into the classroom during PE, video camera or no!
records.en_auxiliary: Th-that's fake! Besides, there shouldn't be any students in the classroom during P.E.! ...Ah!
records.en: Th-That's ridiculous! Besides, students aren't allowed into the classroom during PE, video camera or no!

records.jp: ……どうして、体育の授業中だってわかったのかな？<CR>ライム、いつ撮ったかなんて言ってないよ
records.en_original: ...How did you know this was during PE? I never said when I recorded this.
records.en_auxiliary: ...How did you know this was during P.E.? I never said when I recorded this.
records.en: ...How did you know it was during PE?<CR>Lime never said when it was recorded.

records.jp: そ、それは……
records.en_original: W-Well, I...
records.en_auxiliary: W-well, I...
records.en: W-Well, I...

records.jp: はあ？　あんた、まさかホントに？
records.en_original: Huh!? YOU did this!?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh!? YOU did this?!
records.en: Huh!? YOU did this!?

records.jp: 信じらんない！　自分で盗んで他人のせいにしてたの？<CR>マジありえないんだけど
records.en_original: I can't believe it! You were framing someone else to save yourself? That's just low.
records.en_auxiliary: I can't believe it! You were framing someone else to save yourself? That's just low.
records.en: I can't believe it! You were framing someone else to save yourself? That's just low.

records.jp: ちょっと、何か言いなさいよ
records.en_original: Don't you have anything to say for yourself?
records.en_auxiliary: Don't you have anything to say for yourself?
records.en: Don't you have anything to say for yourself?

records.jp: アンタのせいで、こっちは大恥かいたんだけど？
records.en_original: How long did you think you could play us for fools?
records.en_auxiliary: How long did you think you could play us for fools?
records.en: How long did you think you could play us for fools?

records.jp: 早く説明しなさいよ！
records.en_original: Hurry up and talk!
records.en_auxiliary: Hurry up and talk!
records.en: Hurry up and talk!

records.jp: ……や……めて
records.en_original: ...St-Stop.
records.en_auxiliary: ...S-stop.
records.en: ...St-Stop.

records.jp: 千紘……？
records.en_original: Chihiro...?
records.en_auxiliary: Chihiro...?
records.en: Chihiro...?

records.jp: や……めてー！！
records.en_original: I s-said...stop!!
records.en_auxiliary: I s-said...stop!!
records.en: I s-said...stop!!

records.jp: 千紘！
records.en_original: Chihiro!
records.en_auxiliary: Chihiro!
records.en: Chihiro!

records.jp: ああ、そっちだったんだ……。<CR>もう、手間がかかるなあ
records.en_original: Yeah, I thought that'd do it. Sheesh, a Reflector's work is never done.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, she's the one who went rampant? Sheesh, a Reflector's work is never done.
records.en: Yeah, I thought that'd do it. Sheesh, a Reflector's work is never done.

records.jp: ライム？　まさかあの子に何かしたの？
records.en_original: What did you do to her, Lime!?
records.en_auxiliary: Lime, did you do something to her?!
records.en: What did you do to her, Lime!?

records.jp: ううん。あの子には何もしてないよ。<CR>でも、今回はそれが正解だったみたい
records.en_original: Nothing. Which, it appears, was the right move.
records.en_auxiliary: No, nothing at all. Which, it appears, was the right move.
records.en: Nothing. Which, it appears, was the right move.

records.jp: 遅かった……！
records.en_original: I'm too late...!
records.en_auxiliary: I'm too late...!
records.en: I'm too late...!

records.jp: ユズ！？
records.en_original: Yuzu!?
records.en_auxiliary: Yuzu!
records.en: Yuzu!?

records.jp: ヒナちゃん、話は後。ひとまずコモンに行ってこの子を助けるよ
records.en_original: Don't worry Hina, I'll fill you in later. But first, we've got to go to the Common and help this girl.
records.en_auxiliary: Don't worry, Hina, I'll fill you in later. But first, we've got to go to the Common and help this girl.
records.en: Don't worry Hina-chan, I'll fill you in later. But first, we've got to go to the Common and help this girl.

records.jp: わ、わかった
records.en_original: O-Of course.
records.en_auxiliary: O-Of course.
records.en: O-Of course.

records.jp: 了解
records.en_original: Roger that.
records.en_auxiliary: Roger that.
records.en: Roger that.
